I escalated the Acme Logistics label printer ticket, tkt_0001 ("Label printer offline in DC-3"), to the on-call agent.

What I did:
1. Found the customer Acme Logistics (cus_0001). Acme Paper Co. (cus_0002) also matched "Acme", so I used the exact name.

3. Escalated tkt_0001 with the reason: "SLA breached: label printer offline in DC-3 for Acme Logistics; resolution deadline 2026-03-02T08:00:00Z has passed." I did not reassign or edit the ticket before escalating.

Result: HTTP 200. The ticket is now status "escalated", escalation_level 1, assignee agt_0003, and escalated_at 2026-03-02T09:00:02Z. sla_breached is still true.

I did not separately confirm that agt_0003 is the level-1 on-call agent. The escalate action assigns the on-call agent itself, so I relied on its response.
